subject: Execution logistics: signatory validation and single-envelope approach
messages:
From: Nicole Dunn <nicole.dunn@acme-corp.com>

Cc: legal@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution logistics: signatory validation and single-envelope approach

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together. A few items from legal that will determine how we route the envelope: 

- Our GC needs the MSA to reflect the minor redline in section 7.2 (data residency addendum) before signing. Counsel attached a marked PDF.
- Purchase order value exceeds our threshold for a single signer; finance requires an approval email chain preserved in the envelope or as an attachment.

We're fine with DocuSign but request: 1) one envelope containing MSA + Order Form + the PO approval PDF; 2) an explicit signer role for an authorized signatory (we are preparing a POA in case the primary signer is unavailable).

I can prep the PO approval PDF and the signatory authorization (short) if you confirm final documents.

Thanks,
Nicole
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Acme Corp

Attachment: acme_msa_section7_redline.pdf (PDF)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Dunn <nicole.dunn@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Aug 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Execution logistics: signatory validation and single-envelope approach

Nicole — appreciate the clarity. Quick plan below and a couple of asks from our side: 

Plan (single-envelope approach):
- Envelope will include: MSA v5 (clean), Order Form (final), PO approval PDF, Signatory authorization (if provided).
- Routing order: Acme signer -> Acme witness (optional) -> Redwood signatory -> Countersign (if required by our legal).
- We will include the redline PDF as an attachment inside the envelope for auditability; the executed MSA will be the clean PDF in the envelope.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the authorized signatory name and title (the person who will click sign)? We need an exact match to the authority doc.
2) If the POA is required, please upload the scanned POA to the Drive link above by EOD and copy me; we will attach into the envelope.

Operational notes: 
- DocuSign settings: enable 'Signer must adopt signature' and require 'email-only' authentication for Acme. We can add SMS auth if you'd prefer higher assurance.
- We will set the envelope to 'Require sign in order' so the signature sequence is auditable.

I'll route a draft envelope for review (no send) so your counsel can confirm fields; once you confirm the signer identity we will send.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ACME_MSA-v5_redlines.pdf (PDF, redline), OrderForm-ACME-final-diff.txt (text diff)

We reviewed the redlines. Confirmed from counsel: the change to 7.2 is acceptable and we can sign once that clause is reflected in the clean MSA. A couple of comments for your workflow team: 

- Please ensure the executed PDF is a flattened PDF (no editable fields) and that the signing certificate, history, and attached redline PDF are included in the DocuSign certificate-of-execution bundle.
- If you will be countersigning on behalf of Redwood, please ensure the person signing has an internal approval entry (we can accept an email confirmation from Redwood finance copied into the envelope).

We will provide the signer name today: Emily R. Collins, VP Procurement. We'll also attach the PO approval (screenshot) to the Drive link.

Thanks,
Acme Legal

Attachment: signer-authority-delegation.pdf (PDF)

- [x] Clean MSA reflects sec 7.2 edit (per Acme counsel) — attached as ACME_MSA-v5_clean.pdf in Drive.
- [x] Order Form final numbers checked by Ben (csv + diff attached).
- [x] Signer name: Emily R. Collins, VP Procurement (confirmed by Acme legal).
- [x] PO approval PDF uploaded (Nicole) and included as evidence in envelope.
- [ ] Redwood signatory: who will countersign? Laura — can you confirm person and include internal approval note into the envelope (email is fine)?
- [x] DocuSign options: 'Require sign in order', 'Flatten executed PDFs', include redline as attachment in certificate.

Ben — please review the Order Form final diff and confirm pricing parity so I can lock the envelope. Laura — as soon as you confirm the countersigner and copy an approval email into the Drive, I will prepare the draft envelope in DocuSign and share a non-sent preview link for your counsel to inspect fields.

If there are no further legal asks we should be able to get both signatures completed within 24 hours of sending.

Regards,
